about_the_game:
Sanity Loops

Sanity Loops puts you in the shoes of a student trying to find his place in a world full of strange occurrences and unexpected twists. What begins as a simple search for a job to earn money for a gift for Stacey quickly escalates into a deeper journey, challenging your perception of reality. As you take on a job at a local kiosk, you begin to experience increasingly bizarre and unsettling events that make you question what is real.

Main Features

You got ability to receive messages from NPCs via chat

Interactive dialog system with ability to make choices. Every choice got his own affect!

Experience in-game desktop with ability to find job! (Mini game will be available right after demo)

Other 

  • Atmospheric environment and photo-realistic graphics.

  • VHS film aesthetic.

  • Pleasant interaction with products and items

Gameplay

A first-person exploration game (walking simulator) where realism plays a key role. Walk through realistic locations, discover strange truths, and face unexpected challenges.

short_description: Caught in a strange series of events, you find yourself stuck in a job you never expected. What started as a simple way to earn money for a gift soon spirals into something much darker. As you navigate your new reality, the boundaries between what’s real and what’s not become harder to distinguish.
